item.title: Folio 0.4.3
item.description:
Added

  • ⌘C copies the selected clip without pasting; the shelf closes and focus returns to the previous app. *Copy* is also in the card's context menu.

Changed

  • Text cards show the lines after the title and fill the card, compact cards included; the first line is no longer repeated.
  • Settings explains what to do when Accessibility is on in System Settings but Folio still cannot paste: an entry left by an earlier build must be removed first.
  • Preview is a Quick Look-style window, two thirds of the screen, with no buttons or zoom. Space, Esc or a click elsewhere closes it; a link's address is clickable.

Fixed

  • Opening the preview no longer pushes the shelf up.
  • The shelf opens on the newest clip; one copied while it was hidden no longer leaves the selection on an older card.

item.title: Folio 0.4.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • Sync no longer stalls when another Mac changed the same record first: the conflict is merged and the waiting changes upload. *Sync now* no longer waits out the retry delay.

item.title: Folio 0.4.1
item.description:
Changed

  • Shelf search no longer blanks the shelf on each keystroke: cards stay until new results arrive, and the selection stays while the matches are unchanged. Return and number keys wait for the new results.

item.title: Folio 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Shelf over the Dock: the shelf opens from the bottom edge of the screen, on by default; turn it off in Settings.

item.title: Folio 0.3.1
item.description:
Added

  • Shelf opacity in Settings; fades the shelf background, not the cards.
  • Optional shelf status bar (app name, sync and capture status, key hints), off by default; errors still show.

Changed

  • Number keys 1–9 paste the matching card; ⌘1–9 still works. Cards show the plain number.
  • Settings opens beside the shelf instead of closing it, so changes show as they are made; the opening shortcut closes Settings.

item.title: Folio 0.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • Encrypted iCloud sync between Macs: set up with a once-shown recovery code, key enrolment through iCloud Keychain, sync status in Settings, the shelf footer and the menu, Sync now.
  • Developer-signed builds (Hardened Runtime) on CloudKit's Production environment.
  • Automatic updates: the app checks the public releases feed daily and offers new versions; *Check for Updates…* in the status menu checks now.
  • Releases are built and published by GitHub Actions: pushing the vX.Y.Z tag tests, builds a notarized Developer ID DMG, publishes it and updates the appcast; a dry-run dispatch proves the pipeline without publishing.

Changed

  • Renamed to Folio: the app bundle is Folio.app, the repository cagriy/folio, the update feed cagriy/folio-releases. The bundle identifier, data folder, Keychain items and CloudKit zone are unchanged, so an existing library carries over.

Fixed

  • Settings hides granted permission requests and updates permission status live.
